title: Overrule launches agentic operating system for Supreme Court lawyers
description: Overrule has announced the public launch of its integrated agentic legal operating system, purpose-built for Indian lawyers and designed specifically for advocates and law firms practicing before the Supreme Court of India.Supreme Court litigation involves extensive legal research, multiple rounds of drafting, translation of documents from various Indian languages, analysis of voluminous case records and compliance with strict filing formats and procedural timelines.
